lyrics.ja: いつだって未来のためばかり
lyrics.romaji: Itsu Datte Mirai no Tame Bakari
lyrics.en: Always just for the sake of the future

lyrics.ja: 今という時間を費やすけれど
lyrics.romaji: Ima to Iu Jikan wo Tsuiyasu keredo
lyrics.en: I spend this time called the present
lyrics.zh: 耗費著名為當下的時光

lyrics.ja: 今だけは今だけを感じ合うことができたら
lyrics.romaji: Ima Dake ha Ima Dake wo Kanjiau Koto ga Dekitara
lyrics.en: If only for now, if we can feel just this moment together
lyrics.zh: 如果只有此刻，能共同感受當下的話

lyrics.ja: OFFにして断ち切ったココロがもう1度動き出すよ
lyrics.romaji: Off ni Shite Tachikitta Kokoro ga Mou Ichido Ugokidasu yo
lyrics.en: The heart I switched off and severed will start moving once again
lyrics.zh: 被關掉並切斷的心，將再次開始跳動

lyrics.ja: 震え出しそうな胸の痛みも涙の理由(わけ)もすべて
lyrics.romaji: Furuetashisou na Mune no Itami mo Namida no Wake mo Subete
lyrics.en: This trembling pain in my chest, and every reason for my tears
lyrics.zh: 快要顫抖的胸口疼痛，以及流淚的理由，全部

lyrics.ja: 強さに変えて
lyrics.en: Turn them into strength

lyrics.ja: 飲み込んだ想い
lyrics.en: The feelings I swallowed down

lyrics.ja: 仰いだ空に飛ばせ
lyrics.en: Let them fly into the sky I looked up at
lyrics.zh: 讓它們飛向仰望的天空

lyrics.ja: 繋がるメロディー
lyrics.en: A connecting melody

lyrics.ja: 流れる星に変わってく
lyrics.en: Transforms into a shooting star

lyrics.ja: キミのために歌うよ
lyrics.romaji: Kimi no Tame ni Utau yo
lyrics.en: I'll sing for you

lyrics.ja: キミに届くようにと
lyrics.romaji: Kimi ni Todoku You ni to
lyrics.en: So that it reaches you

lyrics.ja: 輝きは　世界軸を超えてく
lyrics.en: The radiance transcends the world's axis

lyrics.ja: 確かにココで重ね合えた和音(コード)
lyrics.romaji: Tashika ni Koko de Kasaneaeta Koodo
lyrics.en: The chords we truly layered together here

lyrics.ja: 触れ合う音が光になって降り注ぐ
lyrics.romaji: Fureau Oto ga Hikari ni Natte Furisosogu
lyrics.en: The touching sounds become light and pour down
lyrics.zh: 互相觸碰的音符化為光芒傾注而下

lyrics.ja: この一瞬が永遠だと
lyrics.romaji: Kono Isshun ga Eien Da to
lyrics.en: This single moment is eternity

lyrics.ja: 煌めいては色づいてゆく
lyrics.en: Sparkling and gaining color

lyrics.ja: キミと描いた空間(セカイ)
lyrics.en: The world I painted with you

lyrics.ja: いつだって朝は来るだなんて
lyrics.romaji: Itsu Datte Asa ha Kuru Da Nante
lyrics.en: They say morning always comes

lyrics.ja: 来てほしくない朝もあるけど
lyrics.romaji: Kite Hoshikunai Asa mo Aru kedo
lyrics.en: But there are mornings I don't want to come
lyrics.zh: 但也有不希望到來的早晨

lyrics.ja: 夜の闇　息潜め　このまま隠れられなくて
lyrics.romaji: Yoru no Yami Iki Hisome Kono Mama Kakurerarenakute
lyrics.en: Hiding my breath in the dark of night, unable to stay hidden like this
lyrics.zh: 在夜色中屏息，無法就這樣躲藏

lyrics.ja: 静寂を断ち切って叫びたい声を歌に変えた
lyrics.romaji: Seijaku wo Tachikitte Sakebitai Koe wo Uta ni Kaeta
lyrics.en: I cut through the silence and turned the voice I wanted to scream into a song
lyrics.zh: 斬斷寂靜，將想呼喊的聲音化為歌曲

lyrics.ja: いつもそこにある
lyrics.en: Always there

lyrics.ja: 隔て阻む壁も壊して進め
lyrics.romaji: Hedate Habamu Kabe mo Kowashite Susume
lyrics.en: Break down even the walls that divide and block, and move forward
lyrics.zh: 破壞隔絕阻擋的高牆，向前邁進

lyrics.ja: 胸の奥にある
lyrics.en: Deep in my chest

lyrics.ja: 忘れたふりで誤魔化し切れない傷も
lyrics.romaji: Wasureta Furi de Gomakashikirenai Kizu mo
lyrics.en: Even the wounds I can't fully hide by pretending to forget
lyrics.zh: 假裝遺忘也無法完全掩蓋的傷痕

lyrics.ja: 乗り越えてゆく
lyrics.en: I'll overcome them

lyrics.ja: 絡まった想い
lyrics.en: These tangled feelings

lyrics.ja: 音に変えて飛ばせ
lyrics.en: Turn them into sound and let them fly

lyrics.ja: 生まれるメロディー
lyrics.en: A melody is born

lyrics.ja: 激しく鼓動　奏で合う
lyrics.en: Fierce heartbeats play together

lyrics.ja: 言葉だけじゃ足りない
lyrics.en: Words alone aren't enough

lyrics.ja: 歌じゃなくちゃ届かない
lyrics.en: Only a song can reach you

lyrics.ja: 情熱が　胸を熱くさせてく
lyrics.romaji: Jounetsu ga Mune wo Atsuku Saseteku
lyrics.en: Passion makes my heart burn

lyrics.ja: 確かにココで分かり合えたPASSWORD(コード)
lyrics.romaji: Tashika ni Koko de Wakariaeta Koodo
lyrics.en: The code we truly understood together here
lyrics.zh: 確實在此互相理解的通關密碼

lyrics.ja: 時の流れも逆らうように拓かれる
lyrics.romaji: Toki no Nagare mo Sakarau You ni Hirakareru
lyrics.en: It opens as if defying the flow of time
lyrics.zh: 彷彿逆著時光洪流而開啟

lyrics.ja: 何度だって歌うから
lyrics.en: I'll sing no matter how many times
lyrics.zh: 無論多少次我都會歌唱

lyrics.ja: キミの場所がいつも光に
lyrics.romaji: Kimi no Basho ga Itsumo Hikari ni
lyrics.en: So that where you are is always wrapped

lyrics.ja: 包み込まれるように
lyrics.en: In light

lyrics.ja: すべてが崩れ出しそうで
lyrics.en: When everything seems about to crumble

lyrics.ja: どこにも歩き出せないときは
lyrics.romaji: Doko ni mo Arukidasenai Toki ha
lyrics.en: And you can't walk anywhere
lyrics.zh: 當你哪裡也無法邁步時

lyrics.ja: 送り続けるこの音楽(コード)
lyrics.en: This music I keep sending
lyrics.zh: 我會不斷送出這段音樂

lyrics.ja: 聴こえる場所探し踏み出すよ
lyrics.en: I'll search for a place where it can be heard and step forward
lyrics.zh: 尋找能聽見的地方，邁出腳步

lyrics.ja: 遠くの星が呟くように光る
lyrics.romaji: Tooku no Hoshi ga Tsubuyaku You ni Hikaru
lyrics.en: Distant stars glimmer as if murmuring
lyrics.zh: 遙遠的星辰如低語般閃爍

lyrics.ja: いつも何かを伝えるように歌ってる
lyrics.romaji: Itsu mo Nanika wo Tsutaeru You ni Utatteru
lyrics.en: I'm always singing as if to convey something
lyrics.zh: 總是為了傳達些什麼而歌唱

lyrics.ja: 飲み込んだ想い
lyrics.en: The feelings I swallowed down

lyrics.ja: キミと描く音が飛び立つ
lyrics.romaji: Kimi to Egaku Oto ga Tobitatsu
lyrics.en: The sound we paint together takes flight
lyrics.zh: 與你一同描繪的音符展翅飛翔

lyrics.ja: 刹那ティックコードまで
lyrics.en: Even to the momentary tick code
